title: KeywordUpload
description: One row of a keyword CSV upload after header mapping and type coercion (digits in avg_monthly_volume and priority become integers; market is upper-cased; empty cells stay empty). Required columns are marked * in 02-DETAILED-SPECIFICATION §7. A row that fails a required column is rejected with a reason. A row whose volume lacks volume_source or volume_period fails the volume rule below: the importer keeps the row, stores the volume as unknown and records 'volume_missing_source_or_period' (the report shows 'Not available (needs export)').

keyword.description: * Any script; original kept, normalized copy used only for matching. ASSUMPTION: 300 characters.

market.description: * ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (SA, KW, QA, JO, ...) or 'global'.

language.description: * BCP 47 tag such as ar, ar-SA, en.

anyOf.description: Empty cell. For avg_monthly_volume, empty means unknown; never 0.
Empty cell. For avg_monthly_volume, empty means unknown; never 0.

volume_source.description: Required when volume is given, e.g. Google Keyword Planner or Ahrefs.

anyOf.description: Empty cell. For avg_monthly_volume, empty means unknown; never 0.

volume_period.description: Required when volume is given: YYYY-MM to YYYY-MM.

anyOf.description: Empty cell. For avg_monthly_volume, empty means unknown; never 0.
Empty cell. For avg_monthly_volume, empty means unknown; never 0.

target_url.description: Absolute URL on the audited site. Same-site is checked by the importer.

anyOf.description: Empty cell. For avg_monthly_volume, empty means unknown; never 0.

x-migration: additive optional fields bump minor; removals, renames or type changes bump major and need a migration note in docs/decisions.md
x-importer-rules: Reject rows missing keyword, market or language, with a reason per row.
Volume without source or period: keep the row, store volume as unknown, record volume_missing_source_or_period.
Merge duplicates on normalized keyword + market + language.
ASSUMPTION: at most 5,000 rows per upload (02-DETAILED-SPECIFICATION §7).
Cells are stored as text; any later CSV export escapes leading =, +, -, @ to prevent formula injection.
